name: AHG Mirador Viewer
description: Contributes the Mirador IIIF image viewer as an independently installable plugin. Registers a renderer with ahgIiifPlugin's RendererRegistry; install or disable it to choose the viewer.
author: The Archive and Heritage Group (Pty) Ltd

mirador.note: Pinned to a published release. The previous bundle matched no release between 3.0.0 and 3.4.3 and could not be mapped to upstream advisories.
